surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: Eklund forces a shootout with just three seconds left, and the Islanders win it
paras: Jean-Gabriel Pageau got the scoring started for the Islanders early in the second, but Dylan Holloway tied it 1-1 for St. Louis late in the period. Mason McTavish put the Blues ahead 2-1 with six minutes left. With the goalie pulled and just three seconds left, Victor Eklund tied it up for the Isles. Mathew Barzal and Bo Horvat scored in the shootout for the Islanders.

The Islanders carried the play, outshooting the Blues 29-23, but needed a shootout to win it. Ilya Sorokin made 21 saves for the Islanders, and Joel Hofer kept the Blues in it, stopping 27 of 29. The Islanders improved to 12-7-5 and climbed to third in the Metropolitan, while the Blues dropped to 13-9-3, slipping to sixth in the Central.
